gen-megrim-fs-bespoke-sans: Megrim draws every stroke at a measured, drafting-pen thickness, giving its angular letters a futuristic edge. And Bespoke Sans leaves generous space between curve ends and stems, so paragraphs of it feel sharp but unhurried.
gen-megrim-gf-aldrich: Megrim brings angular, futuristic lettering where every stroke ends at the same measured thickness, while Aldrich keeps its x-height close to the capitals. Together they hold the page.
gen-megrim-gf-alexandria: Megrim's c is as open as a bent paperclip. Alexandria's wide terminals and short stems above and below the lowercase keep a long run of text clean and easy to move through.
gen-megrim-gf-anek-devanagari: Megrim's round letters have rims that match their stems, like bent tubing with sharp corners. Anek Devanagari then carries a long passage with distinctly open letter mouths and a generous middle zone, modern and easy on the eye.
gen-megrim-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati has lowercase that rivals its capitals and a gaping c opening, which makes it friendly and clean. Megrim is the one for angular, futuristic display lines with no tilt.
gen-megrim-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads with wide, generous bowls and rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook, clean and approachable. Its best quality is how Megrim's angular, futuristic lines stand against it.
gen-megrim-gf-arimo: Futuristic is the first word for Megrim, whose strokes stay uniform with no thick-thin shifts. Arimo is the counterweight, with spacious gaps in its rounded glyphs and a neutral, professional manner.
gen-megrim-gf-armata: Angular and futuristic, Megrim keeps its rounds and stems in a single weight throughout. And Armata, a neutral, contemporary sans, fills its letter height with lowercase and leaves spacious gaps between characters.
gen-megrim-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-mono: Megrim has no hairline-to-stem shift, just angular, futuristic strokes at one measured thickness. And Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its letters like stencil bridges stretched open, with counters that breathe.
gen-megrim-gf-biryani: Megrim's c is as open as a bent paperclip, and its strokes never vary in thickness. And Biryani gives every e a large, clear eye, so text stays approachable and clean, with small counters never clogged.
